scientific_integrity.computation_role: Supplementary finite consistency tests only; not a substitute for the infinite uniform proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact killed Brownian heat kernel, endpoint-uniform principal eigenfunction comparison, Gaussian density scaling and bounded conditional likelihood ratios.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to ordinary positive Brownian covariances with a standard independent Brownian-bridge component on a unit interval.
Fixed-covariance rank prefactors cannot be substituted for the crossover integral when covariance eigenvalues are of order tolerance squared.
The limit of conditioned endpoints at a singular limiting covariance is generally weak, not total-variation; the moving tilted-Gaussian approximation is total-variation uniform.
Classical heat-kernel and Brownian-motion/bridge special cases are not claimed as new; broader historical priority is not independently settled.
title: Rank-stratified sharp small-ball laws for Gaussian Brownian endpoint processes
